summary: Assess cloud threats, select practical controls, and build recovery playbooks. Explore this five-day cyber resilience course.
lede: Cyber resilience for cloud and SaaS services helps teams assess threats and prepare to sustain or restore critical technology services. The course is for IT managers, security operations staff, cloud administrators, risk officers, and continuity planners who turn threat findings into controls and recovery actions. Learners map identity attack paths, review SaaS logging and backup coverage, set recovery priorities, and draft playbooks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support cyber resilience decisions across cloud and hybrid IT, including those responsible for security controls, service continuity, and recovery reporting.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with IT operations, cloud services, information security, or business continuity is expected. No coding or programming is required; exercises focus on control analysis, structured worksheets, and playbook design.
